name: ai-playbook
description: Ryan Duncan's curated Claude Code setup: Superpowers as the core loop, plus the skills that fill its gaps.

plugins.name: playbook
plugins.description: Ryan's own skills: set up a project's CLAUDE.md, and capture lessons from mistakes.

plugins.name: superpowers
plugins.description: The core loop: brainstorm, write plan, execute plan, TDD, systematic debugging, code review, verification before completion.

plugins.name: pocock-extras
plugins.description: Matt Pocock's skills that Superpowers lacks: grill-me, handoff, retro, wait-what, improve-codebase-architecture.

plugins.name: security-audit
plugins.description: Cloudflare's multi-phase security audit for any codebase. Proposes fixes; never edits your code. Token-heavy: run before releases.

plugins.name: codex
plugins.description: OpenAI's official plugin: independent Codex reviews from inside Claude Code (/codex:review, /codex:adversarial-review). Needs a ChatGPT plan or OpenAI API key.

plugins.name: ponytail
plugins.description: Stops over-building: simplest solution that works, stdlib first, no unrequested abstractions.

plugins.name: react-best-practices
plugins.description: Stack plugin, enable per project. Vercel's React and Next.js rules, including deriving state without effects and moving effect logic into event handlers.

plugins.name: react-native-best-practices
plugins.description: Stack plugin, enable per project. Callstack's React Native performance guide: lists, Hermes, memory, re-renders, React Compiler, Reanimated.

plugins.name: break-ui
plugins.description: Stack plugin, enable per project with a UI. Emil Kowalski's break-ui skill: renders a component with realistic worst-case data, using the limits in the project's own schema, and reports everything that breaks.
